# General data preparation
#### Read in the data
```{r reading the data}

ctrl <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Data/SALL1_overexpression/sall1_2d_day15_ctrl/"), project = "CTRL")
sall1_1 <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/links/groups/treutlein/DATA/sequencing/20230412_P2364_MARINA_MECOM_KO_and_diabetic_BVOs/processed/iMGL_SALL1_gfp_1/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"), project = "SALL1_rep1")
sall1_2 <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/links/groups/treutlein/DATA/sequencing/20230412_P2364_MARINA_MECOM_KO_and_diabetic_BVOs/processed/iMGL_SALL1_gfp_2/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"), project = "SALL1_rep2")

```

```{r create a merged object}

ctrl <- NormalizeData(ctrl) %>%
  PercentageFeatureSet("^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
sall1_1 <- NormalizeData(sall1_1) %>%
  PercentageFeatureSet("^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
sall1_2 <- NormalizeData(sall1_2) %>%
  PercentageFeatureSet("^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
merged <- merge(ctrl, list(sall1_1, sall1_2))

```

#### QC and integration
```{r check QC pre-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
sall1_levels <- factor(c("CTRL", "SALL1_rep1", "SALL1_rep2"))
merged$orig.ident <- factor(merged$orig.ident, levels = sall1_levels)
Idents(merged) <- "orig.ident"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
sall1_col <-setNames(c(c("#E69000","#58B6AC", "#026D7D")), sall1_levels)

pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/nFeature_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/nCount_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/percent.mt_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

```

```{r filter cells and filtering}

# subset cells based on QC metrics
merged <- subset(merged, subset =  nFeature_RNA > 2000 & percent.mt < 30)

```

```{r check QC post-filtering}

pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/nFeature_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/nCount_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/percent.mt_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

```

```{r pre-process and integrate}

sall1_mg <- FindVariableFeatures(merged, nfeatures = 5000) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)
blacklist <- c(unlist(cc.genes.updated.2019), grep("^MT-", rownames(sall1_mg), value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
VariableFeatures(sall1_mg) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(sall1_mg), blacklist)
sall1_mg <- ScaleData(sall1_mg, vars.to.regress = c("G2M.Score","S.Score", "percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA")) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose=F) 

sall1_mg <- cluster_sim_spectrum(sall1_mg, label_tag="orig.ident", cluster_resolution = 1)
sall1_mg <- RunUMAP(sall1_mg, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(sall1_mg,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 46)

sall1_mg <- FindNeighbors(sall1_mg, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(sall1_mg,"css"))) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.6) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 10)

```

```{r save integrated object}
saveRDS(sall1_mg, "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/SALL1_overexpression/sall1_mg_exp1_integrated.rds")

```
